difficulty_reason: The lemma is the Eilenberg-Zilber statement for the functor L pi_!: it commutes with the derived tensor product (statement lines 10350-10361). The proof (proof lines 10363-10390) uses the diagonal and the two projections of the product category, shows the relevant morphism sets are homotopy equivalent to a point, applies the auxiliary computation lemma to the diagonal, and specialises to the tensor product of the pulled-back complexes using the commutation of the pullback with the derived tensor product. H2: one homotopy computation plus one specialisation, written out.
